headline: Oil Prices Rebound Amid Middle East Supply Fears and Refinery Attack
summary: WTI crude oil futures recovered from a three-month low after Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, reviving Middle East supply concerns.
why: Geopolitical tensions and attacks on major energy infrastructure frequently disrupt global petroleum supplies, driving volatility in crude prices.

impacts.name: WTI crude
impacts.why: Supply fears from attacks on energy infrastructure directly drive up crude oil futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reported attacks on critical Middle East refinery infrastructure raised fears of supply disruptions.
